propertySets.name: Pset_FlowInstrumentTypePressureGauge
propertySets.definition: A device that reads and displays a pressure value at a point or the pressure difference between two points.

properties.name: PressureGaugeType
properties.definition: Identifies the means by which pressure is displayed.

properties.name: DisplaySize
properties.definition:
The physical size of the display.

For a dial pressure gauge it will be the diameter of the dial.
